mentions.name: Air-gapped low-bandwidth inference gateways
mentions.description: A prototype of air-gapped or very low-bandwidth inference gateways where interaction with a model happens over narrow channels (serial, optical, audio, etc.) with explicit threat models and monitoring, exploring what inference might look like for AGI/ASI-level systems with a fundamentally different risk profile.
mentions.problem: Assuming unrestricted API inference forever leaves an attack channel for highly capable models, since attackers always have indirect access through inference.
mentions.source_excerpt: For example, we’re prototyping ideas like air-gapped or very low-bandwidth inference gateways, where interaction happens over narrow channels (serial, optical, audio, etc.), with explicit threat models and monitoring.
